main.description: Third-party request to determine whether an entity violates Charter Compliance Rider v2.0 §2(a)-(h). Per ADR-2605192230 + 2605192200. Anyone can submit; Council Lv6+ evaluates.

subjectKind.description: Whether the subject is an EVM address, an Adherent SBT, or a named off-chain legal entity.

subjectAddress.description: 0x-prefixed EVM address. Required if subjectKind = address.

subjectSbtTokenId.description: Adherent SBT tokenId. Required if subjectKind = sbt-token-id.

subjectLegalName.description: Canonical legal name (e.g., 'ACME Defense Industries Inc.'). Required if subjectKind = legal-entity.

subjectAddresses.description: Optional bundle of wallet addresses associated with the legal entity.

allegedViolation.description: Which Rider §2 sub-section the subject is alleged to violate.

evidenceUris.description: URLs / IPFS CIDs / AT URIs of evidence supporting the allegation.

requesterSignature.description: DID-bound signature over the request body (base64url, no padding).
